camel_example: aliyun dcdn DescribeDcdnWafGroup --region cn-hangzhou --Language zh --Scope in --Id 1012
description_en: Queries a custom Web Application Firewall (WAF) rule group. The results are paginated
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnWafGroup查询自定义WAF规则组细则，具体规则可分页
kebab_example: aliyun dcdn describe-dcdn-waf-group --biz-language zh --id 1012 --scope in --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDcdnWafGroup

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

en: English.

zh: Chinese
parameters.help_zh:
语言类型，将以此语言返回。取值范围：

en：英文。
zh：中文
parameters.name: language

parameters.help_en: The ID of the WAF rule group. You can call [DescribeDcdnWafGroups](~~DescribeDcdnWafGroups~~) to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: WAF规则组ID。您可以通过[DescribeDcdnWafGroups](~~DescribeDcdnWafGroups~~)接口查询
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en:
The scope of the rule group to query.

in: returns the rules in the rule group.

out: returns the rules that are in the complete rule set but not in the specified rule group
parameters.help_zh:
待查询规则组的范围。
in：规则内，返回该规则组内的规则。
out：规则外，返回在规则全集中并且不在该规则组中的规则
parameters.name: scope

parameters.help_en:
The query conditions, as a JSON-serialized string. The format is as follows:

`QueryArgs={"PolicyIds":"<IDs of mitigation policies>","RuleIds":"<IDs of rules>","RuleNameLike":"<Rule name>","DomainNames":"<Protected domain names>","DefenseScenes":"waf_group","RuleStatus":"on","OrderBy":"GmtModified","Desc":"false"}`

If you do not specify this parameter, all rules are returned
parameters.help_zh:
查询条件，JSON序列化后的字符串。格式如下：

`QueryArgs={"PolicyIds":"防护策略ID范围","RuleIds":"防护规则ID范围","RuleNameLike":"防护规则名称","DomainNames":"防护域名","DefenseScenes":"waf_group","RuleStatus":"on","OrderBy":"GmtModified","Desc":"false"}`

不传默认查询所有防护规则
